messages.subject: Bioc-training call Dec 8, 3-4pm CET
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

a quick reminder about the Bioconductor training group meeting on Monday, December 8, 3-4pm CET.
As mentioned last time, we would like to propose a (light-weight) governance document for the committee - please see https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BSgzTNzNwW4lzxSdG_YNre7w4DtHbWruG3x1ZIAdTbs/edit?usp=sharing for a draft, and feel free to provide comments before or during the meeting.
Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent

messages.subject: Bioconductor training committee governance proposal - feedback welcome
messages.subject_clean: Bioconductor training committee governance proposal - feedback welcome
messages.body_plain:
Dear Bioconductor Training Committee members,

as mentioned below and discussed in the meeting this week, we would like to propose adopting a light-weight governance document for the committee. The suggested text is available in this document:

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BSgzTNzNwW4lzxSdG_YNre7w4DtHbWruG3x1ZIAdTbs/edit?usp=sharing

With this email, we invite you to read through the document and provide any feedback or suggestions (directly in the document, as comments/suggestions) before next Wednesday (December 17). If no major changes are put forward by then, we will consider the proposed text accepted.

Thank you,
Charlotte, Laurent and Maria

messages.subject: Bioconductor training committee governance document and call for co-chair
messages.subject_clean: Bioconductor training committee governance document and call for co-chair
messages.body_plain:
Dear Bioconductor Training Committee members,

thank you for your comments on the proposed governance document! They have now been incorporated into the draft, and as no suggestions for major changes to the proposed text were put forward, we hereby consider it approved. We have uploaded version 1.0.0 of the governance document to the committee's website (https://training.bioconductor.org/).

With this, we would also like to open the call for nominations for the next co-chair! As outlined in the governance document, if you are interested in taking on this role, please send an email to the current co-chairs (myself and Laurent, cc'ed in this email) with a short candidacy statement, before the application deadline on January 15.

Thank you and all the best,
Charlotte, Laurent and Maria
